agent_explanation: "Shrunk scenario violates pole_upright at step 15 (theta -0.868 rad, limit 0.8) after monotonic divergence from theta 0.10. With dt at maximum 0.02 and sensor_noise 0.017, the controller receives noisy theta and, acting once per outer step, applies mis-timed forces (16-24 N well below force_limit but wrong sign/phase). Omega grows to -7.37 rad/s, cart accelerates to 5.3 m/s, energy rises to 17.0. Counterfactual with sensor_noise=0.0 and otherwise identical plant/steps passes, confirming noise-induced feedback instability at coarse dt is the cause, not plant limits or pushes (none)."
